heading_en: Approval of the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式を用いるには金融庁長官の承認が必要であることを定める。
summary_en: Requires approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency to use the internal model approach.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall obtain the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency when it intends to use the internal model approach.
